source_refs.locator: PDF physical p.55 (printed p.55), climate, care burdens and gender-based violence discussion.

evidence.compact_statement: The 2020 CCA identifies women's resource, information and participation constraints and discusses disasters as potentially exacerbating gender-based violence.
